# The Volume Calculator - Full Technical Reference

> Complete mathematical specifications, volume equations, and unit conversion standards for The Volume Calculator.

## Geometric Formulas

### 1. Cube
- Formula: V = a³
- Surface Area: A = 6a²
- Parameters: a = side length
- Description: Regular polyhedron with six congruent square faces.

### 2. Rectangular Prism (Box)
- Formula: V = l × w × h
- Surface Area: A = 2(lw + lh + wh)
- Parameters: l = length, w = width, h = height
- Description: Three-dimensional solid bounded by six rectangular faces with perpendicular edges.

### 3. Cylinder
- Formula: V = π × r² × h
- Surface Area: A = 2πrh + 2πr²
- Parameters: r = base radius, h = height, π ≈ 3.141592653589793
- Description: Solid bounded by two parallel congruent circular discs connected by a curved lateral surface.

### 4. Sphere
- Formula: V = (4/3) × π × r³
- Surface Area: A = 4πr²
- Parameters: r = radius
- Description: Set of all points in three-dimensional space equidistant from a central point.

### 5. Cone
- Formula: V = (1/3) × π × r² × h
- Slant Height: s = √(r² + h²)
- Lateral Surface Area: A_lateral = π × r × s
- Total Surface Area: A = πr(r + s)
- Parameters: r = base radius, h = height

### 6. Square Pyramid
- Formula: V = (1/3) × a² × h
- Slant Height: s = √((a/2)² + h²)
- Parameters: a = base edge length, h = perpendicular height

### 7. Rectangular Pyramid
- Formula: V = (1/3) × l × w × h
- Parameters: l = base length, w = base width, h = perpendicular height

### 8. Triangular Prism
- Formula: V = (1/2) × b × h_triangle × l
- Parameters: b = triangle base, h_triangle = triangle height, l = prism length

### 9. Trapezoidal Prism
- Formula: V = (1/2) × (a + b) × h × l
- Parameters: a = top width, b = bottom width, h = trapezoid height, l = prism length

### 10. Horizontal Cylinder Tank
- Filled Volume: V_fill = L × [r² × arccos((r - d) / r) - (r - d) × √(2rd - d²)]
- Total Capacity: V_total = π × r² × L
- Parameters: r = tank radius, L = tank length, d = liquid depth (0 ≤ d ≤ 2r)

### 11. Capsule
- Formula: V = π × r² × ((4/3) × r + h)
- Parameters: r = cap radius, h = cylindrical barrel length

### 12. Conical Frustum
- Formula: V = (1/3) × π × h × (r1² + r1 × r2 + r2²)
- Parameters: r1 = top radius, r2 = bottom radius, h = height

### 13. Ellipsoid
- Formula: V = (4/3) × π × a × b × c
- Parameters: a = semi-axis length, b = semi-axis width, c = semi-axis height

### 14. Hollow Cylinder (Pipe)
- Formula: V = π × (r_outer² - r_inner²) × h
- Parameters: r_outer = outer radius, r_inner = inner radius, h = length

### 15. Spherical Cap
- Formula: V = (1/3) × π × h² × (3R - h)
- Base Radius: a = √(h(2R - h))
- Parameters: R = sphere radius, h = cap height (0 ≤ h ≤ 2R)

### 16. Torus
- Formula: V = 2 × π² × R × r²
- Surface Area: A = 4 × π² × R × r
- Parameters: R = major radius (center of tube to center of torus), r = minor radius (radius of tube), where R ≥ r

## Conversion Standards (NIST SP 811 & ISO 80000-3)

- 1 cubic meter (m³) = 1,000 litres (L)
- 1 cubic meter (m³) = 35.314666721 cubic feet (ft³)
- 1 cubic meter (m³) = 264.172052358 US liquid gallons (gal)
- 1 cubic meter (m³) = 219.969248299 Imperial gallons (UK gal)
- 1 cubic foot (ft³) = 1,728 cubic inches (in³)
- 1 cubic foot (ft³) = 0.028316846592 cubic meters (m³)
- 1 cubic foot (ft³) = 28.316846592 litres (L)
- 1 cubic foot (ft³) = 7.48051948 US liquid gallons (gal)
- 1 cubic yard (yd³) = 27 cubic feet (ft³) = 764.554857984 litres (L)
- 1 US liquid gallon = 231 cubic inches = 3.785411784 litres (L)
- 1 Imperial gallon = 4.54609 litres (L) = 1.2009499255 US liquid gallons

## Water Density and Mass Standards

- Water maximum density: 1,000.00 kg/m³ at 3.98°C
- Water standard ambient density: 998.20 kg/m³ at 20°C
- 1 US gallon of fresh water at 20°C: 3.7786 kilograms (8.330 pounds)
- 1 Imperial gallon of fresh water at 20°C: 4.5379 kilograms (10.004 pounds)
